column3: Explanation

Read the commit messages carefully looking for any hints about the reasons for the gap and reasons for the interruption of the gap. In addition; check the project’s GitHub issues; pull requests; and README updates immediately before and after the longest gap especially if the reasons are not completely obvious from the commit messages to clarifies why the project went inactive or became active again. For example; issues may show unanswered bug reports; which could be a possible cause of abandonment. A new pull request after the gap might be evidence of recovery. README changes may indicate maintainers marking the project as "archived" or "revived."
Did the project become active again after the longest gap? Evidence includes new commits; resumed issue responses; or updated README marking the project as revived.
If HasRecovered = yes; describe what triggered recovery. Obtain or infer reason from new commits; resumed issue responses; releases or updated README marking the project as revived.

column2: steady/ rising/ declining/ U-shaped/ stopped/ cyclical /irregular
column3:
Categorize the Project’s long term activity trends
Steady: Consistent activity or commit frequency over time; with no significant upward or downward trend. An upward trend might indicate that a person is becoming more active over several months; while a downward trend could signal a decrease in mobility.
Rising: Sustained and long-term increase in activity; indicating growing engagement or development momentum.
Declining: Gradual long term reduction in activity; suggesting waning participation or project slowdown.
U-Shaped: A period of decline followed by recovery; where activity levels drop and later rise again.
Stopped: Activity has ceased with no signs of recovery or further engagement.
Cyclical: Predictable; repeated patterns of activity occurring at fixed intervals (e.g.; quarterly or annually).
Irregular:Highly variable and unpredictable patterns of activity that do not follow any discernible trend or cycle.
If no commits in the last 6 months as of 2025-09-30 (i.e.; last commit before April 1; 2025). Mark Inactive ; else Active
